expectedUsable: The play controls are reachable and operable by keyboard (Tab to focus, Enter/Space to activate) and announced as buttons with a meaningful name.

violations.expectedFix: Use a native <button> (preferred), or add tabindex="0" plus keydown handling for Enter/Space, so the control is keyboard-reachable and operable. The accessible name is already present.
violations.notes: role="button" with an aria-label gives it a valid accessible name, so axe's button-name rule passes. But without tabindex it is not in the tab order — a keyboard/SR user cannot reach or trigger it (2.1.1). Layer B catches the missing focusability.
